name: Brass
overview: The Bible highlights brass as a significant material in both practical and symbolic contexts. It was a resource mined from the hills of Canaan and used extensively in the construction of the tabernacle, including the laver and its foot made from the polished brass of the women who assembled there. Brass also symbolizes strength and endurance, as seen in the imagery of the earth being like brass and shoes made of iron and brass, representing steadfastness and power. Additionally, brass craftsmanship was a skilled trade, with Tubal-cain noted as an instructor of artisans in brass and iron.
